title: Authorisation Limits on the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card
content:
Every transaction presented on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is measured against the limits its tier carries. These are the limits the card network applies to the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes.

| Card tier | Over-the-counter items in a quarter | Approved groceries in a calendar month | Utilities in a calendar month | Largest single transaction | Transactions in one day | Cash | Retailers accepting the card | Spending on the plan's website |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 150.00 USD | 4 | not permitted | 21400 | not available |
| Select | 90.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 200.00 USD | 5 | not permitted | 28700 | available |
| Plus | 135.00 USD | 45.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 250.00 USD | 6 | not permitted | 34200 | available |
| Premier | 175.00 USD | 58.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 300.00 USD | 6 | not permitted | 41800 | available |
| Dual Complete | 150.00 USD | 130.00 USD | 100.00 USD | 400.00 USD | 8 | not permitted | 52600 | available |
| Chronic Care Plus | 200.00 USD | 160.00 USD | 80.00 USD | 500.00 USD | 8 | not permitted | 47300 | available |

How the columns read. The first three are ceilings on a category inside a period: what is spent on over-the-counter items is counted against the quarterly figure, and what is spent on approved groceries or on utilities against the figure for the calendar month. The largest single transaction is the most the plan will authorise in one presentation; the count is the number of transactions that may be authorised in one day.

A boundary illustration, on hypothetical figures. On a Chronic Care Plus card the largest single transaction is 500.00 USD: a presentation of exactly 500.00 USD is within the limit, and one of 500.01 USD is not. On the same card the over-the-counter ceiling of 200.00 USD sits below the quarterly allowance amount that tier carries, so a member may hold more on the card than they may spend on over-the-counter items in that quarter.

Cash is not permitted on any tier of the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card.
